newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Q2 capacity utilization rises to 82.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Q2 capacity utilization rises to 82.7 pct.

text.p: Canadian capacity utilization in total non-farm goods-producing industries rose 0.3 percentage points to 82.7 percent in the second quarter from a revised 82.4 percent in the first quarter, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.
A survey of Reuter economists had forecast the rate to rise to 83.0 percent in the quarter.

Statistics Canada said the increase in capacity utilization was the first since late 1994. But the agency said the gap between actual and potential industrial output remained wide as shown by the difference between the second quarter of 1996 and the 1988 peak of 86.8 percent capacity utilization.
Manufacturers were the main contributors to the second- quarter increase in capacity utilization, Statistics Canada said.
